data.gender_notes: Parvat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parvat is a name derived from the Sanskrit word parvata, meaning mountain. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture and carries the symbolism of strength, beauty, and calmness. The name Parvat carries the meaning “Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Parvat usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Parvat is a divine name representing the feminine energy of the mountains and the earth. It is believed to bring stability, grounding, and a strong connection to nature.
data.etymology: Parvat belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parvat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Mountains are believed to be the dwellings of gods and goddesses, and Parvat, as the name suggests, represents the divine feminine energy that resides in these natural formations.
data.spiritual_significance: Parvat is a powerful name with spiritual significance in Hinduism. It embodies the strength and grace of the divine feminine, symbolizing the inner wisdom and courage that reside within each individual. The name Parvat also carries the energy of the land, reminding us of the interconnectedness of all living beings and the natural world.
